correctness.rationale: The source identities imply \(\|y_k-s_k\|/\|s_k\|\to0\). Exact two-dimensional secant geometry plus \(y_{k-1}^\top s_k=0\) yields the stated determinant identity, whose two factors tend to one. The next secant relation then determines the first column of the active block up to an \(o(1)\) error; determinant convergence forces the remaining diagonal entry to one. The orthogonal complement is exactly the identity. All denominators are positive.
